versions.changelog:
- Initial release of alibabacloud-oss-media-process.
- Process images, audio, and video files in Alibaba Cloud OSS, supporting 14+ image operations and intelligent media features (IMM).
- Handle audio/video processing tasks such as transcoding, screenshot, animation, sprite sheet, concatenation, metadata extraction, and HLS streaming.
- Supports result delivery via signed URL, download, or saving as a new OSS object; also enables plain file upload/download.
- Enforces secure credential management using Aliyun CLI and SDK default chains; sensitive data handling rules included.
- Detailed prerequisites, preflight checks, and workflow documented for reliable media processing in OSS.
